description: Denominators for all coverage calculations in the terminology index

lexicalCoverage.name: Lexical Coverage Denominator
lexicalCoverage.definition: Total corpus occurrences of all terms meeting inclusion criteria
lexicalCoverage.formula: Sum of totalOccurrences from data/root-occurrences/{root}.json for all included roots

currentEstimate.rationale: Exact count requires running proposed extraction methodology against all 1,576 root files and applying inclusion criteria. Estimated 800-1,200 unique lemmas based on specification.

numerator.definition: Occurrences of included terms that are indexed in terminology-index-v2.json
numerator.targetRatio: 1.0 (100% of included terms' occurrences should be indexed)

lexicalCoverage.notes: This denominator is dynamic — it changes as inclusion criteria are refined. Must be recalculated whenever criteria change.

thematicCoverage.name: Thematic Coverage Denominator
thematicCoverage.definition: Total distinct concepts extracted in MFD-11 Pass A
thematicCoverage.formula: Count of unique terminology entries across all 473 extraction records

currentEstimate.rationale: Current arabic-terminology-index.json contains 649 unique terms. However, this reflects extraction artifacts (whitespace splitting, no normalization), not true thematic denominator. True denominator requires re-extraction using proposed methodology.

numerator.definition: Concepts from Pass A that have corresponding entries in terminology-index-v2.json
numerator.targetRatio: To be determined after scholarly review of scope

thematicCoverage.notes: The 649-term count from the legacy index is NOT a reliable denominator. It includes fragments, non-normalized forms, and terms that may not meet inclusion criteria.

rootCoverage.name: Root Coverage Denominator

numerator.definition: Roots that have at least one lemma included in terminology-index-v2.json
numerator.targetRatio: Depends on inclusion criteria; not all 1,576 roots will qualify

rootCoverage.notes: Not all registered roots will meet inclusion criteria. Many are grammatical particles, rare forms, or lack thematic significance.

corpusTokenCoverage.name: Corpus Token Coverage (Informational Only)
corpusTokenCoverage.definition: Total Arabic tokens in pinned quran-json@3.1.2 corpus
corpusTokenCoverage.formula: Sum of word counts across all 6,236 ayahs

numerator.note: FAHM does NOT target exhaustive corpus coverage. This metric is informational only.

corpusTokenCoverage.notes: The terminology index is a curated thematic lexicon, not a concordance. Low corpus token coverage is expected and acceptable.

priorityRootCoverage.name: Priority Root Coverage
priorityRootCoverage.definition: Coverage of roots identified as thematically priority in MFD-11 workstreams
priorityRootCoverage.formula: Indexed occurrences / total corpus occurrences for priority roots only

currentStatus.note: Coverage percentages vary 4-24% per domain under legacy methodology. Proposed methodology should achieve near-100% for included terms within each domain.

occurrenceCounting.lemmaOccurrences: Each appearance of a specific morphological form counts as one occurrence
occurrenceCounting.rootOccurrences: Sum of all lemma occurrences under that root
occurrenceCounting.distinctAyahs: Number of unique surah:ayah pairs containing any form of the root
occurrenceCounting.repeatedForms: Repeated forms within a single ayah each count separately
